remarks: Welcome to 125 N Taylor Ave, a charming single-family home with modern updates throughout. Featuring a fully renovated kitchen and bathrooms (2022) with new countertops, appliances (refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, microwave, washer/dryer, grinder - all 2022), and fresh paint inside & out. Enjoy gleaming hard wood floors (2022), a new bay window, updated electrical outlets, and a stylish new front door. Major systems include a new roof, boiler, water heater, and toilet (2022) plus central AC/heat (Lennox) installed in 2023 for year-round comfort. Exterior enhancements include tree trimming (2022), adding curb appeal to this move-in ready home.  Located in desirable West Norwalk connected with the golf park area, close to schools, shopping, dining, parks, and commuting options, this home offers both comfort and convenience. (Seller Offering seller concession for closing costs,!!!)
